speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have chronic joint pain; to help you best, please describe the specific joints affected, how long you have had these symptoms, and what factors make the pain better or worse.

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that description. The pattern of pain worsening with activity and improving with rest is classic for osteoarthritis, but given the involvement of the left great toe, hip, and knee over several years, could you describe the appearance of your joints? Do you notice any morning stiffness, and if so, how long does it typically last?
